meaning.en: The act or process of destabilizing.
meaning.vi: Hành động hoặc quá trình gây mất ổn định.

sentences.en: However, 1983 also marked the beginning of severe destabilization.

sentences.en: This was designed before the onset of destabilization, and aimed to restructure the formal school system.

sentences.en: These destabilization campaigns put tremendous pressure on the economies and social services of both countries.

sentences.en: Researchers found that arsenite causes rapid destabilization of the lysosome in cells, and that breaks the lysosome apart, releasing enzymes that destroy these particular kinds of leukemia cells.

sentences.en: Power domination encounters power destabilization in dialogic and dynamic relation.
